summary.text: Peter Antinozzi is the Republican candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Paul Lowe (D) and Green Party candidate Keenen Altic.
He holds a Ph.D. in biomedical sciences.

paragraphs.text: Peter Antinozzi has a Ph.D. in biomedical sciences and a B.Sc. in chemistry and microbiology.
He ran in the Republican primary for North Carolina State Senate District 31 in 2016 and again in 2018, losing both times to incumbent Joyce Krawiec.
He advanced to the 2026 general election in District 32 after the Republican primary was canceled.
